page_title: GRA 1-1 PAL | Granada CF v Las Palmas 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Pejino (Las Palmas) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

90+5' Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+5' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+4' A player from Las Palmas commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+2' Alexander Medina has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) replacing Martin Hongla.
90+1' The manager makes a subsitution with Fabio Gonzalez (Las Palmas) coming on for Enzo Loiodice.
90+1' Marvin goes off the pitch and Saul Coco (Las Palmas) comes on.
90+1' Martin Hongla (Granada CF) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Flag up against Sory Kaba (Las Palmas). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
89' Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
88' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
86' The yellow card is received by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
86' Augusto Batalla (Granada CF) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
85' The game is interrupted now, Augusto Batalla (Granada CF) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
85' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Las Palmas will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' Marvin (Las Palmas) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
82' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
81' Substitution. Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sandro Ramirez walks off.
80' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
78' The total number of attempts is 2:15.

77' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Augusto Batalla, who tips the ball around the post.
76' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer sees the trip by Pejino (Las Palmas) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
74' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
71' Aaron Escandell (Las Palmas) is given a red card for some unsportsmanlike conduct off the pitch.
70' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Pejino (Las Palmas) goes wild in celebration.
69' The Las Palmas players halt their celebrations as referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

68' 1 - 1 Goal! Sergi Cardona clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Pejino (Las Palmas), who gets on the end of it and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the right side of the goal. Augusto Batalla had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.
66' A clever short pass gives Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
64' Close! Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pejino (Las Palmas) will replace Munir El Haddadi.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximo Perrone departs the field of play to be replaced by Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas).
63' Alexander Medina decides to make a substitution. Facundo Pellistri will be replaced by Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF).
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Gonzalo Villar as he is replaced by Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF).
62' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Granada CF, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
59' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 26:74.
58' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
57' Las Palmas take a short corner kick.
55' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
53' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
53' Corner kick. Las Palmas will have an opportunity.
52' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
51' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
49' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Augusto Batalla comes off the line to clear the ball away.
47' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
46' Alexander Medina has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) comes on the pitch for Matias Arezo.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Unlucky! A great strike from Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
45+5' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Carlos Neva (Granada CF) is given a yellow card.
45+5' The main referee, Mateo Busquets Ferrer, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is given a yellow card for dissent.
45+4' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
45+1' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

43' 1 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.
42' A yellow-coloured card is received by Marvin (Las Palmas).
41' A pass by Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
40' Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the right post. Unlucky!
40' The linesman points to the corner flag, Granada CF are going to take it.
39' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Granada CF.
36' Close! Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
35' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
31' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
31' The ball goes out of play. Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
30' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
29' A cross from a corner kick by Las Palmas is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
26' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) has a sight of goal and fires from the edge of the box, but his strike rattles the left post!
26' It will be a corner kick for Las Palmas.
25' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
24' Las Palmas are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
24' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) for Oscar Melendo.
21' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
21' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Augusto Batalla (Granada CF).

20' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF), but referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
20' Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
19' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
17' Las Palmas work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
15' It's a nice effort by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Augusto Batalla. Easy save.
15' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
12' Marvin (Las Palmas) trips an opposition player and Mateo Busquets Ferrer signals a foul.
11' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
9' The corner is swung in but Granada CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
6' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla easily deals with the threat.
6' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
4' The linesman signals a throw-in for Las Palmas.

2' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Las Palmas will take the kick-off.
